summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Ordinary General Meeting held on June 8, 2026. The agenda included amendments to the company's bylaws to improve wording, incorporate provisions from a new Shareholders' Agreement (referenced in an April 23, 2026 Material Fact), update governance practices, and consolidate the bylaws. Shareholders approved all resolutions with overwhelming majorities, including amendments to articles and authorization to align executive board terms with the board of directors. These are routine governance updates, not a special situation. No M&A or restructuring event is described.
